summary: Huawei Cloud's CodeArts (码道) code agent has a free Experience plan (体验版) supporting 50 seats with 5M session-model tokens per month, a 5,000-file Codebase index and 500MB knowledge space. It is a limited trial of the agent's basic capabilities (Q&A, coding, MCP, Rules, Skills), with access via AI IDE, CLI/TUI, JetBrains and VSCode plugins and a built-in GLM model. Paid Basic ($20/seat/month) and Pro ($60/seat/month) plans offer larger allowances.
claim_steps: Open the CodeArts pricing page and sign in or register a Huawei Cloud account
Choose the free 体验版 (Experience) plan and click 立即开通 (Activate now)
